name: BEDROCK
description: Not fury -- foundation: grounded alpha building into firm, steady low beta.

name: COMPASS ROSE
description: An hour through every band, and you choose where to arrive.

name: EARTH'S HUM
description: The planet's own slow ring and its overtones, climbed one rung at a time and back down to the root.

name: FOG BURNING OFF
description: Hazy alpha sharpening up through beta: the fog burns off and the edges return.

name: FULL CHEST
description: The warmth of being thankful, dwelt in: relaxed alpha that slowly swells.

name: HEAVY WATER
description: Down into the low place on purpose, felt all the way through, then up into light.

name: HIGH WINDOW
description: Seeing from a point outside yourself: theta widening, attention ranging free.

name: LEVEL GROUND
description: Back to a calm, awake eight hertz, to clear the pull of the last drift.

name: LONG WARM FLOAT
description: Not euphoria's spike but its long float: a luminous alpha glow drifting softly down.

name: LUCID KEEL
description: For waking inside your dreams: recall sharpened, theta held steady at the helm.

name: OPEN WINDOW
description: Eight to thirteen hertz: awake and present, attention turned inward. The gentlest way in.

name: OUT OF THE LOW PLACE
description: From slow, dim theta the beat climbs toward bright beta: the lift itself.

name: PHOTOGRAPH LIGHT
description: A warm ache for somewhere past: theta, the memory band, letting recollection surface.

name: SEVEN LANTERNS
description: Attention walked up through seven centres, root to crown.

name: SLIPPED MOORING
description: A guided descent to the threshold where the self slips loose from the body.

name: SMALL UNDER STARS
description: Small in the best way: grounded, then the ceiling lifts and everything opens.

name: STILL POND
description: A slow descent into stillness, and then nothing asked of you.

name: THE BINDING HUM
description: The quickest of the brain's rhythms, tied to binding what you sense into one.

name: THE BRIGHT CLIMB
description: Settled first, then lifted: alpha's calm, a quick step into beta, a pause, and a fast rise into a calm, shimmering gamma.

name: THE VAULT KEY
description: The one held back: the slowest bands, for the stillest kind of awe. Strong; not a first one.

name: THRESHOLD
description: Play it first: theta into alpha, to open the doors before another drift.

name: FIRST RAIN
description: Rain arriving on leaves: a settled alpha easing toward theta as the shower steadies in.

name: FOREST AT DUSK
description: Evening under the trees: a stream's hush as alpha fades toward the edge of sleep.

name: TIDE POOL
description: The sea breathing in and out over a rock pool: a theta that swells and ebbs like the tide.

name: WIND ON THE RIDGE
description: An open ridge in a long wind: a slow alpha that lifts and falls with each gust.

name: ALL STRINGS AT REST
description: Harmony first, then all the way down: its beat settles into deep delta, so play it when you mean to rest.

name: BELOW THE TIDE
description: Slower than half a hertz -- heard as the sound slowly moving, not as a beat, and nothing is known of what it does. A curiosity.

name: DOWN FEATHER
description: A weightless drift toward sleep, cradled and watched over: alpha to theta, then delta.

name: LANTERN DOWN
description: Out of busy alpha into the very lowest beats, as deep as sound can carry you.

name: RAIN ON THE SILL
description: Calm and lifted at once: the noise rinsed out, everything settling into place.

name: SOFT GRAVITY
description: From high to low in twenty minutes: stress melting downward into delta.

name: THE DEEP FLOOR
description: The slowest band of ordinary sleep: half a hertz to four, dreamless and deep.

name: THE DOORWAY HOUR
description: Four to eight hertz: the borderland between waking and sleep, where images surface.

name: THE OPENED HAND
description: When worry grips, it eases the rise; taken at night, it opens into theta and lets you go.

name: THE QUIET POCKET
description: A pocket of peace in a busy day: the chatter hushed, steady alpha all the way through.

name: THE TWILIGHT GATE
description: For night visions: down two and back one, again and again, to the gate at seven; then low to four, back to the gate, and home.

name: AFTER-HOURS ELIXIR
description: Dance till the sun catches you: lights, waves of bliss, euphoria streaming through.

name: ALLOY TONIC
description: A hybrid that stirs rather than dulls, nudging you up to the next tier.

name: AMBER CORRIDOR
description: A lift into giggling looseness, then a drift away from the body, each stage a door further down.

name: BLUE EMBER
description: For intimacy: steady to begin, and staying open for more.

name: BLUE-SKY BITTERS
description: Bitters for the morning after: low, gentle tones to ease the head and settle the stomach.

name: BREAKING-CLOUD CORDIAL
description: The grey haze of a flat day lifted: bright, clearing tones, and room to think.

name: BRIEF BALLOON
description: Ten minutes: a quick rise into giggling exhilaration, and as quick a return.

name: CHAIN-REACTION CORDIAL
description: Low and patient, then climbing, climbing, until it crests almost too bright to hold.

name: CLEAR DESK
description: Attention sharpened and held; hunger and tiredness pushed to the back of the room.

name: CLIFF-EDGE ETHER
description: Eyes shut at the lip of a cliff: vertigo, a slow spin, thin crisp air.

name: CUSHIONED FALL
description: Discomfort turned down and warmth rolled over you, the edges of the day softened.

name: DARK ROAST DROPS
description: Five minutes, like the first cup before the world's awake: a warm lift of alertness.

name: DAYDREAM DRAUGHT
description: Theta's floodgates opened: recall, fantasy, imagery and raw inspiration.

name: DENSE AMBER
description: The same mellow lift pressed tighter: heavier, longer, slower to leave.

name: DESERT-DREAM PHILTRE
description: Fantasy threaded with dream recall, and moments of lucid control.

name: EMBER BALM
description: The contented warmth after the heat has burned down, to simply lie in.

name: EVEN KEEL
description: Peaks and valleys smoothed into a steadier line: less weather, more ground.

name: EVENING-STAR OIL
description: From a faint shimmer into the body itself: tingling, warmth, a slow spreading heat.

name: FIRST ALARM
description: The body's own alarm: the heart quick, the senses wide, every muscle ready to move.

name: FIVE-PETAL SUNRISE
description: A gentle warming of mood, contentment returning the way morning light does. The mildest of them.

name: GLASS NIGHT
description: Relentless wakefulness: surging, sleepless energy with no sign of a floor.

name: GREEN SWING
description: A mellow lift, thoughts wandering somewhere philosophical, time stretching, everything a little funnier.

name: HEART ROLL
description: Energy braided with warmth: closeness, touch and music turned up, kind words easy.

name: HIGH-NOON OIL
description: Straight up to the edge: hard, good, no waiting.

name: HIGHLAND FROST
description: A climbing brightness: alert, talkative, sure of yourself, the mood lifted and sharpened.

name: ISLAND HUSH
description: An earthy, numbing calm that loosens body and mind alike: sociable, slow, unbothered.

name: LAUREL TONIC
description: The state of already having won, before the game, the workout, the speech.

name: LIGHTNING TONIC
description: A quick rush laced with euphoria and crystal clarity, opening into wide, fast thought.

name: LIVING WALLS
description: Energy and laughter rising, then colours breathing and patterns moving: the world quietly alive.

name: LONG-NOTE BALM
description: A short listen before intimacy: the body settled, the moment stretched out.

name: MORNING SWING
description: Feeling swings wide and fast, fear to delight and back, then settles into a dreamy hush.

name: MORPHEUS COTTON
description: Sinking into slowness, wrapped in numb, padded comfort.

name: QUIET CROWN
description: For a pounding head: from an ordinary alpha down into a deep, dimmed delta that lets it ease.

name: REBOOT SALTS
description: Ten minutes of stuttering pulses and surges: the signal scrambled, then rebooted clean.

name: RIGHT-HAND ENGINE
description: Thoughts racing ahead of you, the heart loud, everything at once and none of it smooth.

name: RISING CHORUS CORDIAL
description: Wave stacked on wave into a full-body rush, each pass a little higher.

name: ROSE AND BRIAR BALM
description: Pleasure braided with a little pain: warm numbness, rolling waves, a sharp edge.

name: RUST AND RUMOUR
description: Made more of story than of substance: a low, strange unease that turns into an odd lucidity.

name: SAGE'S TILT
description: The world tips into a new, shimmering angle: a short, deep displacement.

name: SATED SYRUP
description: Appetite quieted: cravings hushed, the will steadied, a calm and satisfied stop.

name: SCARLET DUSK
description: An opening glow that eases into a drowsy, dreaming half-sleep.

name: SLOW HONEY
description: Everything slowed to a crawl and sweetened: heavy-lidded, sedated, content.

name: SPIRITS AT DUSK
description: Shoulders loosening, a lift in mood, then the easy giddiness of a long table.

name: STEADY-HAND TONIC
description: For the room full of strangers, the mic, the test: shyness eased, footing found.

name: STRIKE OF FLINT
description: A fast, bright spark: confidence and alertness arriving at once, and leaving as quickly.

name: SULPHUR SPRINT
description: Wide awake and pushing forward: energy surging, focus narrowing, rest postponed.

name: SUMMIT SALTS
description: Smelling salts for the effort ahead: three tiers climbed to sharpen you before the work.

name: SUN BUTTON
description: A mystical loosening of the self, the senses knocked out of joint, the body very far away.

name: THE BREATH-LONG WORLD
description: In one breath the ordinary room is gone, and somewhere vast and certain stands in its place.

name: THE EMERALD HOUR
description: Lucidity arriving slowly: speech turning articulate, ideas linking up, the mind clear and strangely bright.

name: THE FAR HOLLOW
description: Dreamy thinking and clumsy limbs, then a step back from the body, watching from further off.

name: THE HEAVY TIDE
description: The strongest of the warm, sinking kind: one full wave with nothing holding it back.

name: THE LOOSENED LINE
description: Theta's border, where habits loosen: for shifting an attitude, or a behaviour.

name: THE SWOON PHILTRE
description: Falling in love, in the body: the heart swooping, a warmth spreading.

name: THE WAKING GEAR
description: Thirteen to thirty: the everyday working mind, climbing to sharp attention.

name: TIDAL TONIC
description: A tide of well-being, and riding on it a spike of alertness that scrubs the fog away.

name: TWO-TONE BLOOM
description: Colour rising at the edges of things; light gathering halos and scattering into patterns.

name: UMBRA DROPS
description: The calming one: everything glows, then the light is drawn quietly away.

name: UNFOLDING TWENTY-FIVE
description: A sharp opening, then a stream of thought that loosens and wanders into a wide, quiet bliss.

name: UNMARKED PHIAL
description: No label, no promises: press play and see what is on the other side.

name: WARM UNDERTOW
description: A surge of warmth, then a slow pull down into heavy, wordless comfort.

name: WATERFALL OIL
description: Sensation rolling in wave after wave after wave.

name: WHITE HORIZON
description: Everything at once, then nothing at all: a total dissolving into bright stillness. The strongest; begin with another.

name: WILDFIRE
description: An explosive, restless push, rougher than the rest; hard to sit still inside.
